title: Corpus
subtitle: Interactive 3D anatomy atlas
desc: Build and dissect the human body in 3D. Fill the gaps with the male model's skull, ribs, muscles, vessels and nerves, then peel layers, pull muscles apart or cut the body from the top or front. English and Arabic.

title: Heart & Brain
subtitle: Clinical 3D atlas
desc: Tap any chamber, vessel or brain region to see its anatomy and clinical relevance. Watch a beating heart, follow the blood flow, switch lobes and functional areas, and slice through with a section plane.

title: Inner Voyage
subtitle: A journey through the human body
desc: Five stops through the body, from a beating heart to a strand of DNA. Drag to turn the body, then tap a glowing label.

title: LIFE
subtitle: The journey of evolution
desc: An interactive 3D timeline of the history of life. Each claim shows how strongly the evidence supports it and how its dates were measured. English, Arabic and Norwegian.

title: CareOS Twin
subtitle: Clinical workspace, replay
desc: Explore a synthetic patient record: results, care pathway, tasks, notes and an audit trail. This is a recorded replay, so nothing needs to be connected.

title: Humanity
subtitle: The journey of belief
desc: Fly through human history, compare beliefs side by side, visit sacred places in 3D, and ask the historian questions answered from the sources.

title: Miracles in the Quran
subtitle: Testing a viral claim against the numbers
desc: Checks the claim that verse numbers encode Earth's core depth. Shows what holds up, what does not, and how other well-known 'miracles' are read.

title: Norway Economy Simulator
subtitle: Official statistics, simulated to 2035
desc: Every krone, person and industry, from official statistics since 2000 to a simulated 2035. Spin the 3D model, scrub through time and change the levers. Figures from Statistics Norway and Norges Bank.

title: NORGE EVA · Build Lab
subtitle: Build a 3D astronaut suit
desc: Explore a 3D astronaut suit, drive it with keyboard or gamepad, follow the build steps, and view its blueprint and cost.

title: ASTRA TWIN
subtitle: Astronaut, suit and mission as one system
desc: Rotate a 3D astronaut model, switch between body, suit and mission views, run scenarios and replay a timeline.

title: Lunar Site Navigator
subtitle: Pick a site near the lunar south pole
desc: Pick dates and candidate sites near the lunar south pole, then compare sunlight and Earth-in-view windows. Synthetic data.

title: Commercial Building, City Centre
subtitle: A 3D building from DWG drawings
desc: Orbit and zoom a 3D commercial building, cut it at any floor and spread the floors apart. Toggle glass, plans and labels.

title: Walkway Commercial Block 39
subtitle: A 3D four-level commercial block
desc: Orbit a 3D four-level commercial block, cut it at any floor, and toggle glass, plans and labels.

title: Night Circuit Arcade
subtitle: Three games in one neon arcade
desc: Neon Drift, a synthwave racer with blasters and missions; Void Dominion, a real-time strategy battle against a commander; and Endless Saga, a dungeon-crawling RPG. Best played on a phone in portrait.

title: Norsk Quest
subtitle: Learn Norwegian by playing
desc: Learn Norwegian from zero to C2 with a gamified path, job tracks, mini-games and grammar, at your own pace.

title: Robot Workshop
subtitle: Build a working robot, one part at a time
desc: Volt, your guide, explains what each part does. Build the robot, program it and test it in the arena across three missions. Works with mouse, touch or a VR headset.

title: Crucible Frontiers
subtitle: A real-time strategy game
desc: Pick a faction and a mode, then fight in real time. Includes a tutorial, survival and a battle lab.

title: Gorgov Valley of Creation
subtitle: A WebGL night-desert world
desc: Scroll through a night-desert world built around Gorgov Digital's pyramid logo. Seven scarabs are hidden in it.

title: Harness Builder
subtitle: Design AI agent harnesses
desc: Build and compare AI agent harness diagrams by dragging nodes, with templates and an architect flow.

title: Heimdall Network Watch
subtitle: Network security dashboard
desc: A threat radar, map, risk matrix and filters for network security, shown on demo data.
